categoryDescription: Paraphrase - Moderate lexical overlap with shared domain terms

sourceDocuments.title: Urban Hydrology in Emerging Economies
sourceDocuments.text: Rapid urbanization without adequate infrastructure leads to severe groundwater depletion and environmental contamination in developing metropolitan regions.

studentDocument.title: Hydrological Crises in Modern Cities
studentDocument.text: Metropolitan regions experiencing rapid growth without proper municipal systems suffer from diminished groundwater supplies and polluted environments.

labelRationale: SIM-V1 is an n-gram lexical engine. When vocabulary is substantially paraphrased, 3-gram overlap is zero. Token overlap is ~25%. Expected: low similarity or NO_MATCH under strict lexical limits.
knownLimitations: Pure lexical n-gram engines cannot detect deep paraphrases without semantic embeddings.
